description: AMBIGUOUS (X18). With auth_mode ApiKey, usage.estimated_usd values that do not match ^\d+(\.\d+)?$ (negative, exponent, text, empty, leading or trailing dot, comma, spaces, currency sign or suffix) and non-string values (doubleValue, intValue) yield nothing; "1.5", "0.000125" and "12" yield cost-only reports.
contract: ADR-0016 Changes 2026-10-29 (S5c design review D0) M2 ("usage.estimated_usd must match ^\d+(\.\d+)?$; anything else is ignored"); ADR-0016 Changes 2026-10-29 (S5c design) C5 Token and cost mapping; spec §6 (cost_usd non-negative number)

events.derivation: Cost-only report (C5): codex.turn_cost with auth_mode ApiKey, usage.estimated_usd "1.5" matches ^\d+(\.\d+)?$ (D0 M2) → cost_usd 1.5; no token counters, no model; event id from (salt, codex-cli, conversation, turn.id SENTINEL_TURN_U10_OK1).
